687     await conn.execute(
688         f"""
689         INSERT INTO reporting_agent_profile (
690             agent,
691             first_seen_month,
692             last_seen_month,
693             active_months_count,
694             distinct_store_count,
695             distinct_firma_count,
696             distinct_regional_count,
697             distinct_asm_count,
698             months_since_last_seen,
699             reactivation_count,
700             longest_active_streak,
701             career_total_sales,
702             career_total_quantity,
703             avg_monthly_sales,
704             best_month,
705             best_month_sales,
706             current_status
707         )
708         WITH lifecycle AS (
709             SELECT
710                 agent,
711                 import_month,
712                 total_sales,
713                 total_quantity,
714                 first_seen_month,
715                 is_reactivated,
716                 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY agent ORDER BY import_month) AS row_num,
717                 { _MONTH_INDEX_SQL.format(alias='import_month') } AS month_index
718             FROM reporting_agent_lifecycle_month
719         ),
720         streaks AS (
721             SELECT
722                 agent,
723                 COUNT(*)::INT AS streak_length
724             FROM (
725                 SELECT
726                     agent,
727                     month_index - row_num AS streak_group
728                 FROM lifecycle
729             ) grouped
730             GROUP BY agent, streak_group
731         ),
732         best_months AS (
733             SELECT DISTINCT ON (agent)
734                 agent,
735                 import_month AS best_month,
736                 total_sales AS best_month_sales
737             FROM reporting_agent_lifecycle_month
738             ORDER BY agent, total_sales DESC, import_month DESC
739         ),
740         store_scope AS (
741             SELECT
742                 agent,
743                 COUNT(DISTINCT site_code)::INT AS distinct_store_count,
744                 COUNT(DISTINCT firma)::INT AS distinct_firma_count,
745                 COUNT(DISTINCT regional)::INT AS distinct_regional_count,
746                 COUNT(DISTINCT asm)::INT AS distinct_asm_count
747             FROM reporting_agent_month
748             GROUP BY agent
749         ),
750         latest_month AS (
751             SELECT MAX(import_month) AS latest_month
752             FROM reporting_agent_lifecycle_month
753         )
754         SELECT
755             lc.agent,
756             MIN(lc.first_seen_month) AS first_seen_month,
757             MAX(lc.import_month) AS last_seen_month,
758             COUNT(*)::INT AS active_months_count,
759             COALESCE(MAX(ss.distinct_store_count), 0)::INT AS distinct_store_count,
760             COALESCE(MAX(ss.distinct_firma_count), 0)::INT AS distinct_firma_count,
761             COALESCE(MAX(ss.distinct_regional_count), 0)::INT AS distinct_regional_count,
762             COALESCE(MAX(ss.distinct_asm_count), 0)::INT AS distinct_asm_count,
763             GREATEST(
764                 ({latest_month_index}) - ({max_month_index}),
765                 0
766             )::INT AS months_since_last_seen,
767             COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lc.is_reactivated)::INT AS reactivation_count,
768             COALESCE(MAX(st.streak_length), 0)::INT AS longest_active_streak,
769             COALESCE(SUM(lc.total_sales), 0)::NUMERIC(12, 2) AS career_total_sales,
770             COALESCE(SUM(lc.total_quantity), 0)::INT AS career_total_quantity,
771             CASE
772                 WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(lc.total_sales), 0) / COUNT(*), 2)
773                 ELSE 0
774             END::NUMERIC(12, 2) AS avg_monthly_sales,
775             MAX(bm.best_month) AS best_month,
776             COALESCE(MAX(bm.best_month_sales), 0)::NUMERIC(12, 2) AS best_month_sales,
777             CASE
778                 WHEN GREATEST(
779                     ({latest_month_index}) - ({max_month_index}),
780                     0
781                 ) >= 2
782                 THEN 'churned'
783                 WHEN GREATEST(
784                     ({latest_month_index}) - ({max_month_index}),
785                     0
786                 ) = 1
787                 THEN 'inactive_recent'
788                 ELSE 'active'
789             END AS current_status
790         FROM lifecycle lc
791         CROSS JOIN latest_month lm
792         LEFT JOIN streaks st
793             ON st.agent = lc.agent
794         LEFT JOIN best_months bm
795             ON bm.agent = lc.agent
796         LEFT JOIN store_scope ss
797             ON ss.agent = lc.agent
798         GROUP BY lc.agent, lm.latest_month
799         """
800     )
